policy.zh: 优先使用项目仓库或作者页面中的设备实拍、界面截图与硬件图；只有缺少清晰原图时才使用项目专属示意插图，并明确标注不是实机照片。
policy.en: Prefer device photos, interface screenshots and hardware images from the project repository or author page. Use a project-specific illustration only when no clear original is available, and label it as not an actual device photo.
